name: Gestura
tagline: Move the mouse with hand gestures over a sensor board and click with voice commands.
problem: People with limited mobility need touch-free computer control.
solution: Hand gestures sensed by the sponsor's board move the cursor; voice commands handle clicks, scrolling and holds.
demo_moment: Team-described: steer the cursor by hand and say 'left click'.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of FREE-WiLi” among 122 submissions.
Inspired by a demo at the sponsor's workshop.

lessons: Sponsor workshops are idea sources; build on what they show.
